features.name: Flexible Drop Shipment Operation Sequences
features.description: 2026 wave one allows flexible ordering of operations for drop shipments. Previously, posting receipt/shipment was required first, then sales invoice, then purchase invoice. Now purchase and sales operations can be processed independently.

features.name: Get Order Lines Functionality
features.description: New functionality called get order lines serves as a more elaborate replacement for get receipt lines, allowing more flexible handling when invoices are connected to multiple orders or receipts.
caveats: Requires receipt on invoice toggle activation for certain scenarios

features.name: Multiple Purchase Document Creation Methods
features.description: Drop shipment purchase documents can now be created from sales order page, order planning page, planning worksheet, requisition worksheet, or directly in purchase order. Previously limited to requisition worksheet or one-by-one purchase order creation.

features.name: Drop Shipment Support in Order Planning
features.description: Order planning page now calculates sales demand including drop shipment lines, respecting them as part of the planning process.

features.name: Receipt on Invoice Toggle
features.description: New toggle for purchase invoices that enables posting receipt and invoice together directly, updating the related purchase order and shipment automatically without separate receipt posting.

features.name: Undo Shipment for Drop Shipments
features.description: Ability to undo drop shipment shipments to cancel transactions and return items to vendor for reprocessing, providing error recovery capability.

features.name: Direct Receipt and Invoice Posting in Purchase Order
features.description: Purchase orders can now be posted as both receipt and invoice immediately in a single operation, with shipment automatically updated.
